resolution.note: krn verify runs lint, check, targeted, red-first (assertion vs import), preflight and diff-check as one command

title: Run the lead verification as one command with a red-first verdict
body:
Outcome: one command (e.g. `krn verify --base <sha> --observer <file>...`) runs lint, check, the targeted suite, red-first (base tree plus each observer, reporting assertion vs import failures separately), preflight and git diff --check, and prints one PASS/FAIL line per step plus an overall exit code. Observer red at base.
Evidence: PR #167 lead composed this by hand three times (after the worker, after review attempt 1, after the pre-review fix), including a temporary base worktree with a node_modules symlink; one red-first round found a case failing by ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND instead of assertion. Archive .krn/archive/worktree-runs/fix-review-gate-admission-20261102T165601Z/.
